verdict.rationale: Nitrokey documents its own Entra ID provisioning, passwordless login to Microsoft services such as Office 365, and U2F/OTP login to Google, so it does work with two of the named IdPs. The evidence is mostly titles and one-line claims, and policy enforcement requiring hardware keys is not documented as a Nitrokey capability. missing for 10: Okta integration evidence, Google Workspace admin-level integration (only consumer Google login is shown), documented policy enforcement requiring hardware-key authentication, in-depth Entra provisioning docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the key integrates with my identity provider — Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace — and I can enforce policies requiring hardware-key authentication

citations.quote: Forget your password to log in to Microsoft services (e.g. Office 365) and Nextcloud and use Nitrokey for passwordless login instead.
Login to websites (e.g. Google, Facebook) using secure One Time Passwords (OTP), U2F or ordinary static passwords.
Windows Login and S/MIME Email Encryption with Active Directory
